articles.article_text: The upgraded Tesla Model 3 has started reaching customers in China, marking a significant milestone for Tesla Inc. (NASDAQ: TSLA ). What Happened: Celebrations are in order as Tesla commences the first deliveries of the upgraded Model 3. The news was shared by Tesla’s Asia unit on Wednesday, highlighting Shenzhen, Beijing, and Jiaxing as key locations for these initial handovers. articles.title: Tesla CEO Elon Musk Joins Fans In Mocking XPeng For  Copying  Its UI - XPeng ( NYSE : XPEV )
articles.title_clean: Tesla CEO Elon Musk Joins Fans In Mocking XPeng For Copying Its UI - XPeng ( NYSE : XPEV )
articles.article_title: Tesla CEO Elon Musk Joins Fans In Mocking XPeng For 'Copying' Its UI - XPeng (NYSE:XPEV)
articles.article_text: What Happened: Ray , a Tesla enthusiast, shared a video of XPeng’s center screen with the caption, “Does XPeng's latest UI visualization look familiar to you?” Other X users couldn’t help but note the increased likeliness between the user interface and that of Tesla’s FSD. “Exact replica of $TSLA ,” a user wrote. “No. It's looks very original and they 100% didn't copy Tesla,” another joked. “All copies show who the true leader is,” yet another added. Musk himself joined other fans and responded to the video with a ‘thinking face’ emoji. Interestingly, Tesla itself had sued one of its former engineers in 2019 for copying the source code of its Autopilot program before joining the U.S. unit of XPeng. The case was later settled in 2021. Check out more of Benzinga's Future Of Mobility coverage by following this link .
